name: Faneuil Hall
heritage: National Register of Historic Places listed place; National Historic Landmark; Boston Landmark
type: assembly hall; market hall; event venue
text: Faneuil Hall (, , or ) is a historic building in Downtown Boston, Massachusetts, United States. Opened in 1742, the building was designed by artist John Smibert as a marketplace and meeting hall. Faneuil Hall is sometimes referred to as "the Cradle of Liberty", having been the site of many speeches, debates, and other events over its history.
